matched_route_findings.activation_quantization: The selected SM87 FP8 Marlin kernel deletes the configured input scale and executes BF16 activation times FP8 weight. Activation quantization is not an explanation for the owner-observed gap.
matched_route_findings.gdn_numerical_mismatch: The pinned vLLM FLA route retains an FP32 authoritative state across a C64 chunk before casting the boundary state. Q3X freezes BF16 authoritative state after every token, so FLA state algebra is a reference mechanism rather than an exact production replacement.
matched_route_findings.fused_fp8_scale_constraint: Real-checkpoint fused partitions share input-scale bits but not all weight-scale bits. An exact Q3X fused QKVZ or QKV body must preserve partition-specific original codes and scales instead of inheriting vLLM max-scale requantization.

vllm_logger_semantics.formula: sum of received PrefillStats.computed since reset / actual monotonic elapsed since reset
vllm_logger_semantics.request_boundary_behavior: partial Prefill chunks do not emit EngineCore output and therefore do not publish PrefillStats to the logger; the complete logical prompt count can land atomically in a later logger interval
vllm_logger_semantics.claim_boundary: The interval logger sample is service-window accounting rather than a per-request pure-Prefill timer. This distinction does not lower or replace the owner-established 4.3K tok/s planning constraint or the observed 1-2 second long-Agent product target.
